title: A non-pth-power in a finite type characteristic-p domain is detected by a derivation
statement: Let $p$ be a prime number and $B$ an integral domain with $p=0$ in $B$, with fraction field $M$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Assume that there are a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local ring $(R_0,\mathfrak m_0)$ which is $\mathfrak m_0$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring] and a ring map $R_0\to B$ of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Let $f\in B$ be an element which is not a $p$th power in $M$. Then there is a derivation $D:B\to B$ (an additive map with $D(ab)=aD(b)+bD(a)$) with $D(f)\neq0$.

lean.statement: theorem exists_apply_ne_zero_of_not_pth_power (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [CharP B p] (M : Type v) [Field M] [Algebra B M] [IsFractionRing B M] (R₀ : Type w) [CommRing R₀] [IsNoetherianRing R₀] [IsLocalRing R₀] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R₀) R₀] [Algebra R₀ B] [Algebra.FiniteType R₀ B] (f : B) (hf : ¬ ∃ x : M, x ^ p = algebraMap B M f) : ∃ D : Derivation ℤ B B, D f ≠ 0

reviewed_lean.note: p prime=Fact p.Prime; B domain p=0=IsDomain+CharP B p; M=IsFractionRing B M; R0 Noetherian local m0-adically complete=IsNoetherianRing+IsLocalRing+IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R0) R0; R0->B finite type=Algebra.FiniteType; f not pth power in M=not exists x:M, x^p=algebraMap f; additive Leibniz D:B->B with D f /= 0 = exists D : Derivation Z B B
